segments.name: healthy grocery stores
segments.description: Operates specialty grocery stores selling fresh, natural and organic foods and better-for-you products to health-focused shoppers across the United States.
segments.evidence: The Company has one operating segment, and therefore, one reportable segment: healthy grocery stores.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay at Sprouts stores for fresh, natural and organic groceries, in store or through delivery and pickup.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company derives all its revenues from the sale of products at its various store locations across the United States.
